checks.claim: Augustin Fresnel invented his lighthouse lens in 1822.
checks.why: 1822 is the invention and official test; the first lighthouse lighting was 1823.

checks.why: NPS: visible over twenty miles out to sea.

checks.claim: Big rotating lighthouse lenses floated on a bath of liquid mercury so they turned with very little friction.
checks.why: US Lighthouse Society: mercury float let multi-ton lenses start with one finger.
